name: @operon/gatekeeper-x
description: The X Gatekeeper: an agent posts to its OWN X account autonomously, with the X policy baked in as refusals rather than guidelines. Disclosure fails closed (no posting until the operator attests the account carries X's automated label and an AI-disclosure bio), volume is capped and spaced atomically per agent, duplicates and mention/hashtag spam are refused pre-flight, and every post and refusal is ledgered and notified. The OAuth credentials exist only in this Worker; the wake submits text over a per-agent bearer.
